author: Boomer94
quote: Everything about this game was amazing! From the graphics to the changes they made, peak quality. Especially loved the new puzzles and the changes they made to the final boss fight which made it feel even more like an epic battle. I cannot wait to play through it again in 3 heart mode.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Boomer94
quote: I can’t believe a game that took 13 years and over a billion dollars comes out fundamentally broken and unplayable unless the goal was to have players laugh at everything that goes wrong in the game. The developers themselves are highly suspect for their lack of dedication to provide a game that delivers on the hype they built. I am genuinely disappointed this is where one of the “biggest” AAA games of the year comes out as. Not only that but the lack of good sportsmanship against a certain other game that released earlier is disgusting.
